# E.A.M. status

**Generated by `scripts/build_eam_status.py` — never hand-edit.**
`--check` runs in CI. Regenerate after any roster, gap-record or
workflow change.

A state is **done** when it is Examined, Answered and Maintained,
at which point its session moves from expansion to maintenance. The
mark is computed on every run and **goes backward** the moment a
tranche lands without records, a district stops naming anyone, or a
roster loses its scheduled job.

Coverage completeness is reported and is deliberately **not** a bar.
Holding a state open until every county ships hands the definition
to county publishers; a county that will never publish a map would
keep a state open forever while telling a reader nothing.

- **ny** — no county tier, so E does not apply. New York City — the instance serves five boroughs, not a county frontier, so there is no county to examine.
